notes.title: The sequel to Capitaine Lycop: L'invasion des Héters is now available.
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I am pleased to announce that the sequel to Capitaine Lycop: L'invasion des Héters is now available on Steam: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2599560/Ataraxie/]Ataraxie[/url]

However, Ataraxie is intended to stand alone from the original series at first glance.

This time, we’ve opted for a Metroidvania! We offer multiple endings, each accessible depending on your skill level. The less daring players will only scratch the surface of the story and won't understand the connection to the first game. Only the most persistent players will reach the true ending and fully appreciate this sequel.

We hope you enjoy this sequel, and we promise seasoned players around ten hours of gameplay on their first attempt. Two difficulty levels are available: Scribe (easier but disables the true ending) and Pharaoh (the real game).

If you love a challenge and pushing your limits, join the adventure in Ataraxie!

notes.title: Captain lycop becomes FREE !!!
notes.content:
Captain Lycop: Invasion of the Heters becomes free on Steam from 03/01/2023.

Embark on the adventure! Only your weakness will prevent you from defeating the Heters.

notes.title: Captain Lycop now for 1.99$
notes.content:
In order to repel the "Invasion of the Heters" once for all, we decided to lower the investment cost for pilots ready to criss-cross the universe and face certain death.

We expect you numerous & pumped.

notes.title: Patch Coward out on March 3rd 2017
notes.content:
In this patch, we decided to help non-hardcore gamers.

We added a training mode. It contains three levels acting as an advanced tutorial.

Moreover, we implemented two difficulty modes.
The "Coward" mode with more savepoints.
The "Brave" mode who correspond to the current difficulty in the story mode.

We added an achievement for the brave ones.

 
Warning:
Your previous save points are considered as the "brave" mode.
If you want to continue with them, you won't have access to the new save points.
